format: 1: wit story (Akbar-Birbal style), answer included, loops
answer_note: Jamil lends one camel: 18 -> 9 + 6 + 2 = 17, and his own camel is left over.

overlay.html: 17 OONT

lines.caption: Teen doston ne inaam mein satrah oont jeete.
lines.say: तीन दोस्तों ने इनाम में सत्रह ऊँट जीते।
lines.en: Three friends won seventeen camels as a prize.

lines.caption: Shart yeh thi: Raju ko aadhe, Faisal ko teesra hissa, aur Zara ko nauvan hissa.
lines.say: शर्त ये थी: राजू को आधे, फ़ैसल को तीसरा हिस्सा, और ज़ारा को नौवाँ हिस्सा।
lines.en: The rule: Raju gets half, Faisal a third, and Zara a ninth.

lines.caption: Satrah ka aadha? Saadhe aath oont? Ek oont ko kaatein kya?!
lines.say: सत्रह का आधा? साढ़े आठ ऊँट? एक ऊँट को काटें क्या?!
lines.en: Half of seventeen? Eight and a half camels? Do we cut a camel in half?!

overlay.html: 17 OONT

lines.caption: Kisi oont ko kaate bina, kaise baantoge? Socho!
lines.say: किसी ऊँट को काटे बिना, कैसे बाँटोगे? सोचो!
lines.en: How would you share them without cutting a camel? Think!

lines.caption: Lo beta, mera ek oont bhi le lo!
lines.say: लो बेटा, मेरा एक ऊँट भी ले लो!
lines.en: Here, take one of my camels too!

lines.caption: Ab atharah! Aadhe nau, teesra hissa chhe, aur nauvan hissa do.
lines.say: अब अठारह! आधे नौ, तीसरा हिस्सा छह, और नौवाँ हिस्सा दो।
lines.en: Now eighteen! Half is nine, a third is six, and a ninth is two.

lines.caption: Nau, chhe aur do... kul satrah! Ek oont bach gaya.
lines.say: नौ, छह और दो... कुल सत्रह! एक ऊँट बच गया।
lines.en: Nine, six and two... seventeen in all! One camel is left over.

lines.caption: Aur mera oont, wapas mere paas!
lines.say: और मेरा ऊँट, वापस मेरे पास!
lines.en: And my camel comes right back to me!
